messages:
maria: quick q — we still consider 'fallback-to-smaller-model' a client-visible event? :thinking:
ashwin: yes but we shouldn't surface it as an error. it's an optimization fallback. expose as routing_hint maybe.
taylor: problem: customers see 200 + altered content and blame model quality. need UX badge in console + header.
maria: proposal: server returns 200 but sets header: `x-rw-fallback: variant=smaller,reason=capacity` and console shows 'degraded route' banner.
sophie: what about retry semantics? if smaller-model fallback is not functionally equivalent, clients might want to re-run on user's side.
ashwin: add header `x-rw-retryable: false` for non-equivalent fallbacks. default true for transient infra failovers.
maria: ok so two separate signals: fallback_kind (equiv|non_equiv|throttled) and retry_hint (true|false)
ashwin: +1. also telemetry: tag traces with `route_fallback=smaller-v2` and emit metric `fallback.count` with labels.
ops: deploy-bot: new config applied to staging at 3219876600 — watch metric `fallback.count` :rocket:
taylor: console UX: add small pill next to req with tooltip 'degraded route used — click to see alternatives'.
sophie: copy suggestion: 'We routed this request to a lower-capacity model to preserve latency. Output may differ.'
maria: objections? privacy/compliance folks — does exposing model variant leak infra details? @ops
ops: it's just variant id; for sensitive customers we can opt out per tenant. flag `expose_routing=false`.
ashwin: last point: status code mapping. Should smaller-model fallback return 207? feels weird. Keep 200 but put `x-rw-status: degraded`.
taylor: agree. 207 would be confusing for clients and SDKs. keep 200, include machine-readable header and console badge.
sophie: add rollout gating: only show console badge after enabling feature flag for tenants.
maria: ok actionables: (1) infra: emit `fallback.count` + labels (ashwin) (2) API: add headers `x-rw-fallback-kind`, `x-rw-retryable`, `x-rw-status` (ashwin/taylor) (3) console: pill + tooltip + opt-out flag (taylor) (4) docs + sample SDK parsing (sophie)
ashwin: i'll do metrics + headers PR today.
taylor: i'll mock console pill and add copy.
sophie: i'll draft docs and SDK snippet.
maria: thanks — meet in 30 to confirm rollout plan. :thumbsup:
